diff --git a/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go b/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..58871cdf9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go
@@ -0,0 +1,368 @@
+package trafficpolicy
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"slices"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	envoyroutev3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/config/route/v3"
+	envoy_type_matcher_v3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/type/matcher/v3"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/durationpb"
+
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway"
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/pkg/utils/regexutils"
+)
+
+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	disable         bool
+	headers         []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader
+	cookies         []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie
+	queryParameters []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter
+	filterState     []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState
+	sourceIp        *kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIp
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherCH, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil && otherCH == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherCH == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c.disable != otherCH.disable {
+		return false
+	}
+	if !slices.EqualFunc(c.headers, otherCH.headers, func(a, b kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader) bool {
+		if a.HeaderName != b.HeaderName || derefBool(a.Terminal) != derefBool(b.Terminal) {
+			return false
+		}
+		if (a.RegexRewrite == nil) != (b.RegexRewrite == nil) {
+			return false
+		}
+		if a.RegexRewrite != nil && b.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			if a.RegexRewrite.Pattern != b.RegexRewrite.Pattern || a.RegexRewrite.Substitution != b.RegexRewrite.Substitution {
+				return false
+			}
+		}
+		return true
+	}) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if !slices.EqualFunc(c.cookies, otherCH.cookies, func(a, b kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie) bool {
+		if a.Name != b.Name || a.TTL != b.TTL || a.Path != b.Path || derefBool(a.Terminal) != derefBool(b.Terminal) {
+			return false
+		}
+		return slices.Equal(a.Attributes, b.Attributes)
+	}) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if !slices.EqualFunc(c.queryParameters, otherCH.queryParameters, func(a, b kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter) bool {
+		return a.Name == b.Name && derefBool(a.Terminal) == derefBool(b.Terminal)
+	}) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if !slices.EqualFunc(c.filterState, otherCH.filterState, func(a, b kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState) bool {
+		return a.Key == b.Key && derefBool(a.Terminal) == derefBool(b.Terminal)
+	}) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if (c.sourceIp == nil) != (otherCH.sourceIp == nil) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c.sourceIp != nil && otherCH.sourceIp != nil {
+		if derefBool(c.sourceIp.Terminal) != derefBool(otherCH.sourceIp.Terminal) {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func derefBool(b *bool) bool {
+	if b == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	return *b
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	if c.disable {
+		if len(c.headers) > 0 || len(c.cookies) > 0 || len(c.queryParameters) > 0 || len(c.filterState) > 0 || c.sourceIp != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("no other fields may be set when disable is true")
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	for _, h := range c.headers {
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.RegexRewrite.Pattern); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid header regexRewrite pattern %q: %w", h.RegexRewrite.Pattern, err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	for _, cookie := range c.cookies {
+		if cookie.TTL != "" {
+			if _, err := parseTTL(cookie.TTL); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: %w", cookie.TTL, err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	return nil
+}
+
+func parseTTL(ttl string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	if ttl == "" {
+		return 0, nil
+	}
+	d, err := time.ParseDuration(ttl)
+	if err == nil {
+		if d < 0 {
+			return 0, fmt.Errorf("ttl cannot be negative")
+		}
+		return d, nil
+	}
+	sec, err := strconv.ParseInt(ttl, 10, 64)
+	if err == nil {
+		if sec < 0 {
+			return 0, fmt.Errorf("ttl cannot be negative")
+		}
+		return time.Duration(sec) * time.Second, nil
+	}
+	return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid duration format %q", ttl)
+}
+
+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+	if ch.Disable != nil && *ch.Disable {
+		out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			disable: true,
+		}
+		return
+	}
+
+	ir := &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:         false,
+		headers:         dedupHeaders(ch.Headers),
+		cookies:         dedupCookies(ch.Cookies),
+		queryParameters: dedupQueryParameters(ch.QueryParameters),
+		filterState:     dedupFilterState(ch.FilterState),
+		sourceIp:        ch.SourceIp,
+	}
+
+	out.consistentHash = ir
+}
+
+// dedupHeaders deduplicates headers by headerName (case-insensitive), preserving first occurrence casing.
+func dedupHeaders(headers []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader) []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader {
+	if len(headers) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(headers))
+	res := make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader, 0, len(headers))
+	for _, h := range headers {
+		lower := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+		if seen[lower] {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[lower] = true
+		res = append(res, h)
+	}
+	return res
+}
+
+// dedupCookies deduplicates cookies by name (case-sensitive), preserving first occurrence.
+func dedupCookies(cookies []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie) []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie {
+	if len(cookies) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(cookies))
+	res := make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie, 0, len(cookies))
+	for _, c := range cookies {
+		if seen[c.Name] {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[c.Name] = true
+		res = append(res, c)
+	}
+	return res
+}
+
+// dedupQueryParameters deduplicates queryParameters by name (case-sensitive), preserving first occurrence.
+func dedupQueryParameters(params []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter) []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter {
+	if len(params) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(params))
+	res := make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter, 0, len(params))
+	for _, q := range params {
+		if seen[q.Name] {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[q.Name] = true
+		res = append(res, q)
+	}
+	return res
+}
+
+// dedupFilterState deduplicates filterState by key (case-sensitive), preserving first occurrence.
+func dedupFilterState(fs []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState) []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState {
+	if len(fs) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(fs))
+	res := make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState, 0, len(fs))
+	for _, f := range fs {
+		if seen[f.Key] {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[f.Key] = true
+		res = append(res, f)
+	}
+	return res
+}
+
+func applyConsistentHash(ir *consistentHashIR, out *envoyroutev3.Route) {
+	if ir == nil || out == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	action := out.GetRoute()
+	if action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if ir.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+
+	policies := buildHashPolicies(ir)
+	if len(policies) > 0 {
+		action.HashPolicy = policies
+	}
+}
+
+func buildHashPolicies(ir *consistentHashIR) []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if ir == nil || ir.disable {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	var policies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	// 1. Headers
+	for _, h := range ir.headers {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+			HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			hp.RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: derefBool(h.Terminal),
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+				Header: hp,
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 2. Cookies
+	for _, c := range ir.cookies {
+		cookie := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+			Name: c.Name,
+		}
+		if c.TTL != "" {
+			if d, err := parseTTL(c.TTL); err == nil {
+				cookie.Ttl = durationpb.New(d)
+			}
+		}
+		if c.Path != "" {
+			cookie.Path = c.Path
+		}
+		if len(c.Attributes) > 0 {
+			attrs := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, 0, len(c.Attributes))
+			for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+				attrs = append(attrs, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+					Name:  attr.Name,
+					Value: attr.Value,
+				})
+			}
+			cookie.Attributes = attrs
+		}
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: derefBool(c.Terminal),
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+				Cookie: cookie,
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 3. Query Parameters
+	for _, q := range ir.queryParameters {
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: derefBool(q.Terminal),
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: q.Name,
+				},
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 4. Filter State
+	for _, fs := range ir.filterState {
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: derefBool(fs.Terminal),
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: fs.Key,
+				},
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 5. Source IP
+	if ir.sourceIp != nil {
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: derefBool(ir.sourceIp.Terminal),
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	// If no sub-fields were specified (policies is empty), default to single sourceIp hash policy with terminal=false
+	if len(policies) == 0 {
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: false,
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	return policies
+}

+func TestApplyConsistentHash_CanonicalTypeOrderAndFields(t *testing.T) {
+	spec := kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec{
+		ConsistentHash: &kgateway.ConsistentHash{
+			SourceIp: &kgateway.ConsistentHashSourceIp{
+				Terminal: ptr.To(true),
+			},
+			FilterState: []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState{
+				{Key: "fs_key", Terminal: ptr.To(false)},
+			},
+			QueryParameters: []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter{
+				{Name: "q_param", Terminal: ptr.To(true)},
+			},
+			Cookies: []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie{
+				{
+					Name: "my_cookie",
+					TTL:  "3600",
+					Path: "/app",
+					Attributes: []kgateway.CookieAttribute{
+						{Name: "SameSite", Value: "Lax"},
+						{Name: "Secure"},
+					},
+					Terminal: ptr.To(false),
+				},
+			},
+			Headers: []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader{
+				{
+					HeaderName: "X-Sub",
+					RegexRewrite: &kgateway.RegexRewrite{
+						Pattern:      "^user_(.*)$",
+						Substitution: "\\1",
+					},
+					Terminal: ptr.To(true),
+				},
+			},
+		},
+	}
+
+	out := &trafficPolicySpecIr{}
+	constructConsistentHash(spec, out)
+
+	route := &envoyroutev3.Route{
+		Action: &envoyroutev3.Route_Route{

+		},
+	}
+	applyConsistentHash(out.consistentHash, route)
+
+	action := route.GetRoute()
+	policies := action.GetHashPolicy()
+
+	// Canonical order: headers, cookies, queryParameters, filterState, sourceIp
+	require.Len(t, policies, 5)
+
+	// 1. Header
+	hPolicy := policies[0]
+	assert.True(t, hPolicy.GetTerminal())
+	require.NotNil(t, hPolicy.GetHeader())
+	assert.Equal(t, "X-Sub", hPolicy.GetHeader().GetHeaderName())
+	require.NotNil(t, hPolicy.GetHeader().GetRegexRewrite())
+	assert.Equal(t, "^user_(.*)$", hPolicy.GetHeader().GetRegexRewrite().GetPattern().GetRegex())
+	assert.Equal(t, "\\1", hPolicy.GetHeader().GetRegexRewrite().GetSubstitution())
+
+	// 2. Cookie
+	cPolicy := policies[1]
+	assert.False(t, cPolicy.GetTerminal())
+	require.NotNil(t, cPolicy.GetCookie())
+	assert.Equal(t, "my_cookie", cPolicy.GetCookie().GetName())
+	assert.Equal(t, int64(3600), cPolicy.GetCookie().GetTtl().GetSeconds())
+	assert.Equal(t, "/app", cPolicy.GetCookie().GetPath())
+	require.Len(t, cPolicy.GetCookie().GetAttributes(), 2)
+	assert.Equal(t, "SameSite", cPolicy.GetCookie().GetAttributes()[0].GetName())
+	assert.Equal(t, "Lax", cPolicy.GetCookie().GetAttributes()[0].GetValue())
+	assert.Equal(t, "Secure", cPolicy.GetCookie().GetAttributes()[1].GetName())
+
+	// 3. Query Parameter
+	qPolicy := policies[2]
+	assert.True(t, qPolicy.GetTerminal())
+	require.NotNil(t, qPolicy.GetQueryParameter())
+	assert.Equal(t, "q_param", qPolicy.GetQueryParameter().GetName())
+
+	// 4. Filter State

+	assert.False(t, fPolicy.GetTerminal())
+	require.NotNil(t, fPolicy.GetFilterState())
+	assert.Equal(t, "fs_key", fPolicy.GetFilterState().GetKey())

+	// 5. Source IP

+	assert.True(t, sPolicy.GetTerminal())

+func TestParseTTL(t *testing.T) {

+	assert.Equal(t, 90*time.Minute, d)
+
+	d, err = parseTTL("3600")

+	p2Ref := &ir.AttachedPolicyRef{

+		Kind:      "TrafficPolicy",
+		Namespace: "default",
+		Name:      "policy2",

+	mergeOrigins := ir.MergeOrigins{}

+	ch := p1.spec.consistentHash

+	// Headers unioned with p1 first, deduplicated by key case-insensitively

+	// Cookies from p1

+	// Query params from p2

+	assert.Nil(t, ch.sourceIp)
+
+	// Merge origins check
+	assert.True(t, mergeOrigins.IsSet())
+	refs := mergeOrigins.Get("consistentHash")
+	assert.Contains(t, refs, p2Ref.ID())
+}

+func TestMergeConsistentHash_Disabled(t *testing.T) {

+	mergeConsistentHash(p1, p2, nil, nil, policy.MergeOptions{}, mergeOrigins, TrafficPolicyMergeOpts{})
+
+	assert.True(t, p1.spec.consistentHash.disable)
+	assert.Empty(t, p1.spec.consistentHash.headers)
+
+	// Higher priority (p1) is enabled, lower priority (p2) is disabled
+	p1Enabled := &TrafficPolicy{
+		spec: trafficPolicySpecIr{
+			consistentHash: &consistentHashIR{
+				headers: []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader{{HeaderName: "X-Foo"}},
+			},
+		},

+	p2Disabled := &TrafficPolicy{
+		spec: trafficPolicySpecIr{
+			consistentHash: &consistentHashIR{
+				disable: true,
+			},

+	}
+
+	mergeConsistentHash(p1Enabled, p2Disabled, nil, nil, policy.MergeOptions{}, mergeOrigins, TrafficPolicyMergeOpts{})
+
+	assert.False(t, p1Enabled.spec.consistentHash.disable)
+	require.Len(t, p1Enabled.spec.consistentHash.headers, 1)
+	assert.Equal(t, "X-Foo", p1Enabled.spec.consistentHash.headers[0].HeaderName)

+func mergeConsistentHash(
+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	opts policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	_ TrafficPolicyMergeOpts,
+) {
+	if !policy.IsMergeable(p1.spec.consistentHash, p2.spec.consistentHash, opts) {
+		return
+	}
+
+	ch1 := p1.spec.consistentHash
+	ch2 := p2.spec.consistentHash
+
+	if ch1 == nil {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = ch2
+		mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}
+
+	if ch2 == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	// Higher-priority policy (p1) is disabled: keep p1's disabled state
+	if ch1.disable {
+		return
+	}
+
+	// Lower-priority policy (p2) is disabled: p1 (higher-priority) takes precedence over p2
+	if ch2.disable {
+		return
+	}
+
+	// Union array fields across both policies with higher-priority (p1) first, deduplicated by key
+	ch1.headers = dedupHeaders(append(slices.Clone(ch1.headers), ch2.headers...))
